title: Orbit and Protocol
author: Theo Pemberton
blurb: Petra Joubert, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the jump window closes.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
